hourglass.summary: Proportions are naturally balanced with a defined waist. Focus on maintaining symmetry, core stability, and highlighting your natural waistline.

fitness.focus: Total-body symmetry and core stability to support spinal alignment and natural curves.
exercises: Goblet squats for quadriceps and glute strength
Dumbbell overhead presses to maintain upper-body posture
Romanian deadlifts for hamstring and posterior chain balance
Side planks and bird-dogs for lateral core stability
fitness.cardio: Moderate-intensity interval training (HIIT) or brisk incline walking 2-3 sessions per week.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 2-3 days full-body resistance training + 2 days low-impact cardio and mobility.

nutritionTips: Focus on balanced macronutrients: quality lean protein, healthy fats (avocado, olive oil), and slow-digesting complex carbs.
Maintain consistent hydration: aim for 2.5 to 3 liters of water daily.
Incorporate regular fiber-rich vegetables to support steady energy levels.
postureTips: Mindful pelvic alignment: avoid excessive anterior pelvic tilt when standing.
Perform daily thoracic spine rotations to maintain upper back openness.
wellness.recovery: 7-8 hours of quality sleep with mindful stretching focusing on hip flexors and lower back.

outerwear: Tailored blazers that cinch at the waist
stylingTips: Highlight your natural waist with belts and fitted cuts.
Choose fabrics with gentle stretch that drape gracefully rather than stiff, boxy materials.
Ensure upper and lower garment volumes remain harmonious.
avoid: High stiff turtlenecks without waist definition

rectangle.summary: Athletic and naturally proportional silhouette with an even balance across shoulders, chest, and hips. Focus on building curve illusion through lateral deltoids, glutes, and waist-cinching styling.

fitness.focus: Hypertrophy for shoulder caps (lateral deltoids) and glutes to enhance anatomical curvature, alongside rotational core strength.
exercises: Barbell hip thrusts for maximum glute development
Dumbbell lateral raises to broaden shoulder cap profile
Walking lunges with dumbbells for lower body contouring
Russian twists and cable woodchops for oblique definition
fitness.cardio: Sprint interval training or stair-climber sessions to encourage lower-body muscular tone.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 3 days targeted resistance training (emphasis on glutes and shoulders) + 1-2 days active recovery.

nutritionTips: Ensure adequate daily protein intake (1.6 - 2.0g per kg of body weight if pursuing muscle tone).
Fuel resistance sessions with pre-workout complex carbohydrates (oats, sweet potatoes).
Maintain balanced electrolyte levels especially on strength training days.
postureTips: Engage core brace during standing to prevent hyperextending knees.
Scapular retractions to keep chest proud and shoulders set back.
wellness.recovery: Foam roll hamstrings and lats post-workout; incorporate dynamic hip mobility routines.

tops: Peplum tops that create waist flounce
Crop tops paired with high-waisted bottoms
bottoms: Mom jeans or curved cargo pants
outerwear: Long duster coats with waist ties
stylingTips: Create the illusion of curves using belts, peplum details, and horizontal textures.
Experiment with dramatic necklines and layered textures to add dimensional depth.
Pair voluminous bottoms with fitted tops or vice versa.
avoid: Vertical pinstripe suits without waist cinching

pear.summary: Hips and thighs form the prominent proportion with a slender upper torso and defined waist. Focus on upper-body posture and strength, and styling that draws the eye upward.

fitness.focus: Developing upper-body breadth (shoulders, chest, and back) to balance hip proportions, plus metabolic conditioning.
exercises: Seated dumbbell shoulder presses to expand biacromial breadth
Lat pulldowns and bent-over rows for a strong, wide upper back
Incline dumbbell chest presses for upper chest fullness
Bodyweight or kettlebell goblet squats for lower body conditioning
fitness.cardio: Incline walking, elliptical training, or rowing to build upper back endurance.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 3 days upper-body focused strength + 1 day metabolic lower-body circuit + 2 days cardio.

nutritionTips: Focus on anti-inflammatory whole foods: berries, dark leafy greens, salmon, and walnuts.
Stay hydrated to support lymphatic drainage and lower-extremity circulation.
Moderate dietary sodium to reduce water retention around the lower body.
postureTips: Avoid slouching the shoulders forward; focus on opening the clavicle.
Practice standing tall with even weight distribution across both feet.
wellness.recovery: Elevate legs after heavy workouts; incorporate hamstring and hip flexor static stretches.

tops: Bright colors and bold horizontal prints on top
bottoms: A-line skirts that skim hips smoothly
Dark wash straight-leg or bootcut jeans
outerwear: Cropped jackets that end above hip bone
Double-breasted pea coats with wide lapels
stylingTips: Draw attention to your upper body with necklines, statement jewelry, and light colors on top.
Keep lower garments streamlined, dark-toned, and unembellished.
Emphasize your slim waistline with fitted cuts.
avoid: Cargo pants with side thigh pockets
Drop-waist skirts that add bulk to hips

inverted_triangle.summary: Shoulders and bust are broader than hips and waist. Focus on lower-body muscular volume to achieve harmony, and styling that softens shoulders while accentuating hips and legs.

fitness.focus: Lower-body hypertrophy (quads, glutes, hamstrings, and calves) to build lower proportion symmetry with broad shoulders.
exercises: Heavy barbell or dumbbell back squats for leg mass
Bulgarian split squats for targeted glute and quad development
Leg press and calf raises for lower leg definition
Cable face pulls for postural shoulder health without excessive deltoid bulk
fitness.cardio: Stair master, cycling, or outdoor hill sprints to build lower-body muscular endurance.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 3 days lower-body focused strength + 1 day light upper-body maintenance + 1-2 days cardio.

nutritionTips: Ensure sufficient calorie and complex carbohydrate intake to support lower-body muscle synthesis.
Consume post-workout meals with a 3:1 carb-to-protein ratio within 90 minutes of training.
Prioritize magnesium-rich foods (pumpkin seeds, spinach) for neuromuscular relaxation.
postureTips: Keep shoulders relaxed away from ears; release tension in upper trapezius muscles.
Strengthen deep cervical flexors to maintain neutral head alignment.
wellness.recovery: Foam roll quads and IT bands regularly; practice deep diaphragmatic breathing.

tops: Deep V-neck and scoop neck tops
Raglan or halter-neck styles that visually narrow shoulders
bottoms: Pleated and A-line skirts with bold prints
dresses: V-neck wrap dresses with full skirts
outerwear: Jackets with minimal or unpadded shoulders
Cocoon or straight coats ending mid-thigh
stylingTips: Create volume on your lower half with bright colors, prints, and flare cuts.
Use vertical lines and deep necklines to elongate and soften broad shoulders.
Keep shoulder lines clean and free of shoulder pads or puff sleeves.
avoid: Boat-neck tops and horizontal stripes across the chest

apple.summary: Midsection is the prominent feature, often accompanied by slender legs and arms. Focus on deep core activation, cardiovascular conditioning, and styling that elongates the torso while showcasing limbs.

fitness.focus: Deep transverse abdominis strengthening, posture alignment, and metabolic conditioning to reduce visceral load.
exercises: Dead bugs and hollow body holds for deep core stability
Farmer's carries for functional core brace and grip strength
Bodyweight lunges and step-ups to build slender leg muscularity
Dumbbell chest supported rows for upper spinal posture
fitness.cardio: Low-impact steady state (LISS) cardio such as incline walking or swimming 3-4 times weekly.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 3 days functional resistance & core stability + 3 days low-impact aerobic conditioning.

nutritionTips: Emphasize fiber-dense meals (flaxseed, legumes, cruciferous vegetables) to promote gut motility.
Incorporate healthy monounsaturated fats while minimizing refined sugars and sweetened beverages.
Practice mindful pacing during meals to prevent postprandial bloating.
postureTips: Avoid leaning backward to compensate for torso weight; maintain tall rib-over-pelvis alignment.
Incorporate daily pelvic floor and transverse abdominis breathing.
wellness.recovery: Prioritize 8 hours of sleep; incorporate gentle restorative yoga or light walking after dinners.

tops: Wrap tops that tie under the bust
bottoms: Slim or straight-leg trousers showcasing legs
dresses: Shift dresses that fall cleanly past the hips
V-neck wrap dresses with diagonal draping
outerwear: Open-front long cardigans and blazers creating vertical lines
stylingTips: Draw attention upward to the face and neckline with V-necks and statement earrings.
Highlight your legs with knee-length hemlines and well-fitted straight pants.
Use monochromatic or vertical color columns underneath an unbuttoned jacket or long cardigan.
avoid: Clingy jersey fabric around the midsection
Wide horizontal belts across the belly
